items.event_time_ist: 8:00 AM MST, Oct 14 (9:30 PM IST, Oct 14)
items.title: Simon weakens to Category 1 (90 mph); Mexico drops its last coastal watch
items.summary: NHC Advisory 29 (8 AM MST Wed Oct 14): Hurricane Simon's max winds fell to 90 mph (150 km/h, 975 mb) at 19.7N 108.1W - ~165 mi WSW of Cabo Corrientes and ~250 mi SSE of Cabo San Lucas - drifting SW at 2 mph. Mexico discontinued the Hurricane Watch for Las Islas Marias, so no coastal watches or warnings remain in effect anywhere. NHC notes watches/warnings may be required for portions of Baja California Sur in the next day or two; a turn toward the north or north-northwest is forecast by Friday, with weakening into the weekend.

items.event_time_ist: 9:00 AM CST, Oct 14 (8:30 PM IST, Oct 14)
items.title: Trudy strengthens to 60 mph; NHC: hurricane tonight, major hurricane Friday
items.summary: NHC Advisory 5 (9 AM CST Wed Oct 14): Tropical Storm Trudy strengthened to 60 mph (95 km/h, 998 mb) at 11.5N 99.5W - ~375 mi S of Acapulco, ~610 mi SSE of Manzanillo - moving WNW at 13 mph. Rapid strengthening is forecast: hurricane by tonight, major hurricane by Friday. The track turns N/NNW Thursday and could bring Trudy near the coast of southwestern Mexico on Saturday. No coastal watches or warnings are in effect, but NHC says watches will likely be required later today or tonight for southwestern and west-central Mexico.
